$comment: Canonical-CBOR bytes of the LCP label-8847 metadatum {v, atrHash} (text-keyed map, RFC 8949 §4.2.1 canonical: keys ordered length-then-bytewise, so `v` before `atrHash`). Authored from the CBOR spec + the proven on-chain shape, then cross-checked BYTE-FOR-BYTE against the independent `cborg` oracle (a throwaway script, since deleted — never a runtime dep). `atrHash` is bare lowercase hex (no 0x), 64 chars = 64 bytes = exactly Cardano's per-string metadatum limit (a 0x-prefixed 66-byte form would overflow, which is why the on-chain value is bare hex). `cbor` is lowercase hex of the metadatum bytes.
